resources.string: Conversion replaces the UNet only. Text encoders and VAE are shared separately, so prompt interpretation and colour may differ from this checkpoint.
On your first SDXL conversion, the shared text encoders and both VAE models download automatically (about 1 GB). They are saved for later conversions.

Too long — keep it under 80 characters.

LoRAs are merged into the weights, so they cost nothing at generation time — but each combination is its own model. The text-encoder half is not applied, so style LoRAs work better than trigger-word ones.
The screen stays awake while this app is visible. Conversion continues in the foreground service when you switch apps.
Saved to %1$s. Import it in your generator as a custom model.
The UNet comes from your checkpoint. SD1.5 uses the shared DreamShaper text encoder and VAE; SDXL uses the separately downloaded text encoders and both VAE models.

SD1.5: 512 × 512, Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 target. SDXL: 1024 × 1024, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 target, INT8 UNet weights. Both model families have working conversion and generation on the tested Galaxy S25 Ultra; other devices remain unverified.
